Difference in Effective Strikes is 5 or less. Follow Criteria by Priority until a Winner can be determined.
If a Winner can be determined, Round to be Scored, Winner 10, Opponent 9.
If no Winner can be determined, Round is a Draw. A Drawn Round is Scored 10 for both Fighters.
Difference in Effective Strikes from 6 to 10. Round to be Scored, Winner 10, Opponent 9.
Difference in Effective Strikes from 11 to 15. Round to be Scored, Winner 10, Opponent 8.
Difference in Effective Strikes from 16 or more. Round to be Scored, Winner 10, Opponent 7.
Any yellow card given to a fighter will result in a 1 Point Deduction to that fighters Round.

For each 90 seconds granted for Armour Failure Repair, 1 Point will be Deduction to that fighters Round.
